title: Quantum Stability Resolver (QSR): frustration-guided quantum-enhanced sampling of community uncertainty in brain networks
description: Code and data for the paper "Frustration-guided quantum-enhanced sampling of community uncertainty in brain networks": the Quantum Stability Resolver (QSR), a quantum-enhanced Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler for the uncertainty of community structure in human brain networks. The archive holds the Python code, the input data, the stored results (raw rows, summaries and run logs) and the analysis plans that were fixed before each study's data existed, with their SHA-256 fingerprints. The studies cover exact computations up to 13 nodes, IBM Heron hardware runs, non-brain controls and a comparison with sampling the quantum device directly.
notes: Code is MIT-licensed; the stored results, analysis plans and documentation are CC BY 4.0. Third-party data in data/external/ keep their own terms: the ENIGMA Toolbox (BSD 3-Clause) and the WU-Minn HCP Open Access Data Use Terms for the connectomes, and the CBIG license (MIT) for the parcel centroids; see data/README.md.
